title: 雅德尼：利率不是更高更久，是正常更久？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Seven years in, we're so far so good. Real GDP all-time record high, stock market all-time record high, so far so good, just three more years.
segments.zh: 七年过去，目前一切顺利。实际GDP创历史新高，市场也创历史新高，到目前为止还不错，还有三年。

segments.en: I mean, there are issues ahead, but it's amazing how well the economy has performed despite all the shocks it's had to absorb since the beginning of the decade, so far so good as I said.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，前方有挑战，但经济表现令人惊叹，尽管自本十年初以来吸收了各种冲击，正如我所说，到目前为止还不错。

segments.en: Well, you are the quintessential card counter when it comes to looking at fixed income markets, and you know your work on debt levels in the US, in France, in abroad, but you know, you're referring to bond yields back to their quote-unquote old normal ear in your latest show. Talk to us about the old normal, I love it.
segments.zh: 嗯，在固定收益市场方面，你可是典型的算牌高手，你对美国、法国等地的债务水平研究颇深，但在你最新的节目中，你提到债券收益率回到了所谓的旧常态。跟我们谈谈旧常态吧，我很喜欢。

segments.en: Well, you know, there's an expression that people used to explain where interest rates are right now, and that is higher for longer.
segments.zh: 嗯，你知道，人们常用一个说法来解释当前的利率水平，那就是更高更久。

segments.en: And I don't know, that just doesn't, it runs me the wrong way quite honestly. I don't think it's higher for longer. I think it's normal for longer.
segments.zh: 我不知道，坦白说，这让我感觉不对劲。我不认为会更高更久，我认为是常态更久。

segments.en: We're back to normal rates. The abnormal rate environment was between the great financial crisis and the great virus crisis. Right before the great financial crisis, we were running between four to five percent, occasionally spiked above five percent.
segments.zh: 我们回到了正常利率。异常利率环境是在大流动性变化和大病毒危机之间。大流动性变化前，利率在4%到5%之间，偶尔超过5%。

segments.en: And you rightly point out that, you know, it's basically if you look at household onings of treasuries or any or corporate owners, it's minuscule compared to where it has been in years past yet.
segments.zh: 你正确指出，基本上，如果你看家庭持有的国债或企业持有量，与过去几年相比，它是微不足道的。
